query:
DELETE c FROM companies c 
LEFT JOIN contact_company_relations ccr ON ccr.companyId = c.id 
WHERE ccr.contactId IS NULL 
AND c.createdAt < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
